## Purpose
Base classes for revision layers that refuse to run once the revision has stopped, whether because an error was set or because the instruction needs clarifying.

## Responsibilities
- `revision_ready(ctx)` requires `ctx.error is None`, a `revision_spec`, and `spec.status == "proposed"`.
- `RevisionDecisionLayer(DecisionLayer)` runs one LLM decision; its `should_run` is `enabled and revision_ready`.
- `RevisionStepLayer(Layer)` does deterministic work, with the same `should_run`.

## Key elements
`revision_ready`, `RevisionDecisionLayer`, `RevisionStepLayer`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
Subclassed by every revision layer except the context and proposal layers, which use `Layer`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
Validating or diffing an unchanged definition after a failure would present "no changes" as if it were a result. That is why these bases stop running.
